articles.title: Show HN: An SSR Java framework for real-time user interfaces and AI agents
articles.summary: This article describes a new Java framework for developing web user interfaces entirely on the server side. It boasts real-time browser synchronization and native AI agent support. Components operate within a Java process, efficiently responding to browser events via WebSockets. This framework streamlines web development by centralizing UI logic, offering an innovative approach to building dynamic web applications with integrated AI capabilities, potentially enhancing efficiency and responsiveness.

articles.title: How to get to shopping heaven in Belfast: great shops you won’t find down south

articles.title: Indian Navy was minutes away from striking Pakistan from sea during Op Sindoor, reveals Chief Admiral Tripathi
articles.summary: Admiral Dinesh K Tripathi, Chief of the Naval Staff, revealed the Indian Navy was minutes away from striking Pakistan from the sea during Operation Sindoor. He stated Pakistan requested a halt, averting the strike. This revelation underscores India's naval preparedness and strategic posture in past conflicts, offering insight into high-stakes decision-making and the nation's defence capabilities.
